about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers diagnostics and engine work, brakes, steering and suspension, tires and wheels. We work out of West Jefferson and the towns around it.

reviews.author: dean t
reviews.text: JD and his crew have always taken great care of our daughter's car as well as my wife's and my vehicles. I had a "check engine light" come on a few days ago and they took me right in. The mechanic "Parker" found the issue quickly and was very helpful with information about my truck. Will be taking it in for full service in a few weeks but was assured that truck is safe to drive until then. To JD, Parker, and all employees, THANK YOU for such great and honest service!!

reviews.author: S Damron
reviews.text: JD and staff have been excellent business partners for years. They keep their customers on the road for longer by installing Jasper Engines and Transmissions.

reviews.author: Maria K
reviews.text: Got my diesel van towed here, broke down on the road, being from a thousand miles away, found this only place around that said they had a diesel mechanic available. Ended up paying $152 for "diagnostics" that I am pretty sure isn't even correct. I asked the mechanic to check the Ecu, which required taking the seat belt bolt off and the side panel, 10 min later I come in the shop the panel was untouched, but he said he checked the ecu and it was fine. Lied , charged me for nothing, had to tow out of here. zero compassion, care or professionalism. All of them working here have this blank stare like lizards, women at their counter included. And as a long time google reviewer i can tell you most of the reviews here are fake. So make a better choice in an auto repair place then I did. Edit after their response: They misdiagnosed the issue , quoting me 3k for shipping fuel injector pump from japan+labour, that would take weeks as he said, knowing i was just passing through twon. While the issue turned out to be electric, just like I asked them to check an ecu and he lied about doing it. AND they balmed my attitude for that?? This shop where you get your vehicle TOWED out of becuase they are useless. The worst of the worst. I've seen a lot of shops in my travels around the whole continent, and truly, when you get one of this type of places its not your good luck. Avoid!

reviews.author: Bryan Norris
reviews.text: I live in Raleigh, my daughter was visiting West Jefferson and had car trouble. JD took her in on the spot, checked her car and took the time to call and review the issue with me. Very kind & honest folks. It would have been easy for them to take advantage of the situation and they did not. (to JD & staff: Thank you!! Bryan)

reviews.author: Tina Calloway
reviews.text: This was my first time going there & could not be more impressed! Everyone was so nice & friendly, they got us in a few minutes before our appointment, they were quick & efficient with what we had done & their prices are more than reasonable. I had a 4 wheel alignment. I found the garage that I'll be going to from now on!

reviews.author: JB BROWN
reviews.text: I always get courtesy service at JD's Auto Care. Their staff is super helpful. It’s a pleasant experience each time I visit.

reviews.author: S. Ashley
reviews.text: JD's did an outstanding job replacing a radiator and fan clutch recently on my Jeep Grand Cherokee they were fairly priced, provided professional workmanship, and excellent customer service! I contacted JD's on a Friday morning having just arrived in town the evening before with no other means of transportation. JD stated while they had a busy schedule that day they would do there best to get my vehicle repaired that same day if I could get it to him that morning! They did this and more, I walked the 20 min or so trip to downtown West Jefferson waiting for the repairs to be completed. Later in the afternoon I received a call updating me on the progress, I mentioned that I need twenty minutes or so to get back to their shop as I was on foot. His team member who called asked where I was located then offered to come pick up me up to obtain my vehicle. I was extremely impressed by their willingness to go over and above during what was an extremely stressful situation. JD and his team really saved my trip! If your ever in the West Jefferson area and have car troubles JD Auto Care is the place to go for all your repairs!!

reviews.author: Julianna Johnston
reviews.text: Bought a battery from another location, but then we had problems with it from something the other place didn’t tend to. He helped us out! Kind and honest people. Highly recommend them. Will be using them for all our car needs!

reviews.author: Adam Tomore
reviews.text: Was in town for vacation and had a check engine light come on. JD's team got me in with zero notice and quickly back on the road. Would visit them again if I had any need while in West Jefferson.

reviews.author: David Ray
reviews.text: We brought our truck in because it was making a clicking noise while turning. JDs inspected it and could find nothing wrong. They did inform us that our model truck will make that noise if left in auto 4wd. They didn't charge us for the work as they found nothing to fix. They were very pleasant and helpful and honest to not try and fix something that wasn't broken.

reviews.author: Dorothy Ray
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing. We brought our 2023 ram 1500 in because it was making a clicking noise while turning. I was Absolutely 100% sure we would need out CV joints replaced and braced for impact on how much time and money it was gonna cost us. It turns out it was a simple fix of turning off my auto 4wd. The integrity from this shop was just beyond my comprehension. They didnt even charge us. They could have absolutely "found" something wrong and charged us whatever to fix it. This is now our go to place for any vehicle issues.

reviews.author: KP in NC
reviews.text: Highly recommend JD's Auto Care in West Jefferson, NC. Can't say enough good things about their work ethic and customer service. That's hard to find these days, so wanted to spread the word. I live in Durham and was visiting West Jefferson when my Jeep's check engine light indicated I had a transmission problem. A different shop was unable to find the issue. JD and Tiffany went above and beyond to help get me back to Durham safely. I love supporting small family owned businesses like JD's Auto Care. Spread the word!

reviews.author: Christopher Holden
reviews.text: Fast, friendly service at a reasonable price. They offer a wide variety of services, so it is a one-stop shop. I trust them with all my vehicles!

reviews.author: Reese N
reviews.text: Best Auto Care around! Best experience, best service My friend and I were visiting West Jefferson and my brake light came on. We called JD's and they told us to come right in. They immediately took my car in and inspected it. They were extremely nice and caring. I felt safe and knew I wasn't going to get scammed. They told me to come back or call whenever I needed anything for my car and I definitely will! I go to Appstate and live in Boone but will 100% take my car to West Jefferson just for their business and hospitality.

reviews.author: Ty London
reviews.text: just helped us get the car in park, and is putting our shift knob on later, great service DIDN’T EVEN CHARGE US! Great people

reviews.author: Emily Davis
reviews.text: These guys are honest and hard-working. Always friendly, always as quick as can be while being thorough. Thanks yall!

reviews.author: Chris Penndorf
reviews.text: Would highly recommend JD’s to anyone in need of repair or general maintenance. They’re honest, skillful, and genuinely care about their customers. We were in town on vacation from a few hundred miles away in Virginia and brought our car in when it was acting up - they wanted to make sure that we would be safe driving home on the long trip and quickly diagnosed and fixed the issue while I waited. I only wish they were in our hometown because they’d easily become our go-to mechanics!

reviews.author: Sabrina Hernandez
reviews.text: Our son had just bought his first car and it needed to be looked over. Josh ran the diagnostics on it, changed out the front brakes and rotors, found the spot that was leaking some oil and fixed that, and passed the inspection. They took the car in the day we brought it to them and had it all fixed up within a few days (had to wait on a part). They know what they are doing, won't cheat you out on pricing and are honest and transparent about everything. Would recommend them to everyone!! Thank you all for being a trustworthy shop in Ashe!

reviews.author: Kenneth Thompson
reviews.text: Used these guys a couple of times and everything was perfect. I feel I can trust them, which is a pretty big deal.

reviews.author: Dana Lucas
reviews.text: I will never go anywhere else for auto repair!! I had a massive coolant leak, and they got me in right away, ordered parts, and had me back on the road the next day. Not only that, but they took great care to keep the car's interior clean - I really appreciated the disposable seat covers and floor mats. The owner, the receptionists, and the mechanics were all super-friendly, showed me the problem and how they repaired it, and explained everything. Plus, the pricing was 100% fair and transparent. My emergency ended up becoming a great experience. 10/10, would recommend! Thanks, JD's!

reviews.author: Chloe Rice
reviews.text: Nice people, Helped me get my issues resolved VERY quickly, In and out. I would highly recommend jds auto care to anyone.

reviews.author: Cari Moisan
reviews.text: I wish we'd found JD's sooner! After a nightmare at another garage in town (for whom I'm leaving a review next...), JD's was a godsend! They're HONEST, helpful, fast, communicative, and really seem to operate with integrity above all else. I'm sold - this is our new garage and am so relieved we found them. We brought our Grand Cherokee in last week, and they test drove it, spent time working on finding the issue, and didn't even charge the diagnostic fee when there wasn't anything to fix! They wouldn't even accept a tip to thank them for their time. So a few days later, we are picking up our Terrain (figures trouble always comes in pairs) and, not only did they diagnose the issue FAST, I had a call back in no time that it was done, that they saved me money, and that it was ready to go. If you want honesty and a really GOOD price, go to JDs.

reviews.author: Kelli Vance
reviews.text: I was so excited to find this place. I had a low tire pressure, and they had no problem taking a look when I stopped by. They discovered the problem, and fixed it. The price was great. A wonderful small town business, that I will definitely be using again. Thank you for your quick help today.

reviews.author: Jordan Hodges
reviews.text: JD has taken care of us several times and always goes above and beyond. He replaced the timing belt on our Acura (a huge job) and had it done in a day! Six months later, we needed tires, called him up and he gave us four solid options at different price points. The tires were there the next day. We also scheduled an alignment, but the night before, the car started making an awful knocking noise. Turns out the timing belt tensioner had a mechanical failure, nothing to do with JD, just a manufacturer defect. Even though we were only booked for an alignment, JD took the time out of his undoubtedly packed schedule to diagnose and fix the issue first before doing the alignment. I can’t recommend him and his shop enough. He actually explains what’s going on, walks you through the whole process, and doesn’t rip you off. Him and his team are the whole damn package, I’ve been spoiled, and honestly, I don’t think I can take my vehicles anywhere else now. Everyone is always incredibly friendly and ready to help you no matter what. Thank you JD’s Auto!

reviews.author: Jennifer Denny
reviews.text: Was looking for an honest, good, local auto repair shop since we moved to Ashe Co a couple of years ago. We previously had our cars serviced in Blowing Rock and that drive was just a bit extra. JD and his team are phenomenal! Courteous, kind, fast, reasonably priced and on our last job they went above and beyond to fix an issue that another auto shop created. Definitely will be back and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jeri Fountain
reviews.text: Thanks to JD's and Taylor, my 1986 Toyota truck runs like a champ again. Professional, thorough, friendly and skilled -- all the things I hope for in a mechanic shop. So happy to have found this place. They recharged the air conditioning on my other vehicle too, so I am riding in comfort. I highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: John Fedor
reviews.text: My first experience with JD was after a friend's recommendation. A mechanic I had previously used for a few years had replaced my mass flow sensor twice... The second time he said the part was bad and he got another one to replace it at no charge. When the same problem occurred again I took it to JD. He told me that the previous part had been installed incorrectly and there was a clip that was not properly employed. He took care of the problem at significant savings to me and I have been taking my vehicles there ever since and never been disappointed. Let's face it nobody wants to spend money on auto repair... But when I need it I'll spend my money at JD's .

reviews.author: Kevin Wells
reviews.text: The owner JD not only took me out into the shop and showed me everything that needed to be done but also explained it to me. Tiffany at the desk was extremely helpful and got me rescheduled with no delay. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

reviews.author: Tim Bell
reviews.text: Had a great first experience with this business! My wife took the car in and everyone was very welcoming and friendly. They even saved us money by not doing something that I thought needed to be done. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Charles “Clint” Jones
reviews.text: I had rotors and brake pads replaced on an older van I bought. Plus there was "a lot" of aftermarket wiring and components on the van that were causing problems. The guys at JD's traced them all down removed them and restored it back to factory setup. All really fast and at a very fair price. JD told me up front what his plan was for chasing the wiring issues and kept me up to date on how it was going. Very pleased with the whole experience. They've got my business going forward.

reviews.author: Alex L
reviews.text: Great work replacing my AC evaporator, everything works great after taking it to JD. These guys are fast and reliable. Price may be a little high depending on what you need done but definitely worth the quality work. Will be returning if I have any issues later on.

reviews.author: David Rairden
reviews.text: I'm from out of town and I had what I thought was a transmission problem. JD checked out my vehicle and showed me it was something much less of a problem. From the moment I arrived to their shop I was treated as if they had known me for years. Truly a great experience. Thank you so much JD and staff

reviews.author: Jeffery Mcgalliard
reviews.text: If I didn't have to put a star up there I wouldn't even put the one I did. I took my Jeep out there to have the brakes and rotors changed but when I was charged an outrageous price I took my Jeep they went to service in return four lug nuts one on each tire I'm serious one of them is melted all the way to the rim this is unsatisfactory and unprofessional business I do not recommend anyone take their vehicle to these people

reviews.author: Brett Shaeffer
reviews.text: JD's team came and picked up my vehicle during a snow storm to install a new after market radio. Although they were unable to get the system working properly they returned the vehicle and did not charge me. We will be back for all future vehicle related needs. Customer service is A+, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Susan Boyer
reviews.text: Took car on Friday 6/7/24 at about 10:30 AM telling JD about problem the brakes were grinding. He checked them out and said both front and brake brakes need replacing. He figured out the exact amount it would cost and said he could get the car in in about 30 minutes. He got it in and had it done at about 2PM. The brakes are going good. I will go back the next time I need work on a car. Thanks JD

reviews.author: Annie Rheaume
reviews.text: I was visiting my sister and was ready to take my stored car on a 10 hr drive to Fla. A couple days before having to leave the brakes started shuttering. The kind mechanic got me in right away and did the brakes quickly and perfectly. They even eliminated a squeak that had been there for years that nobody could figure out! Very professional and reliable Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Chloe Parker
reviews.text: JD Is the Most honest mechanic I have ever met. He always tells you what you need, but does not try to oversell you! Yesterday he was able to fix my car problem that I have had since almost the day I bought it. I have been told it was a factory problem and could not be fixed, but he fixed it for a very reasonable price! Cannot recommend this shop enough!

reviews.author: Collin Blackburn
reviews.text: Good folks here, JD and all of his techs. They did everything they could to help my mother in law with her Volvo that was butchered by another shop, were completely honest and transparent throughout the process, and even allowed me to work alongside JD on the car. I'd trust them with my own cars, and that's saying a lot! Wishing JD and the crew the best of luck going forward with their business.

reviews.author: Abel Warner
reviews.text: Fair shop rates, but like many it gives me great security to have a mechanic who is willing to take you into the shop and show the ins and outs of what is being done to your vehicle. Taylor was the mechanic that walked me through it and performed the work. Going forward I'll be recommending this place to everyone who needs a good mechanic shop.

reviews.author: Keana Blackburn
reviews.text: I called JD Autocare on a Saturday after my car wouldn’t crank. I jumped it off but was afraid something was wrong. They were able to check out my car on Saturday (and let me know I’d just inadvertently let my battery die after they ran diagnostics) My car needed a tune up anyway so I made an appointment for Monday morning. I got there this morning (Monday) a little later than I’d said I would. I also said they didn’t have to rush as I would go find something to do to pass time… instead I had super pleasant conversations with his wife and before I knew it my car was done! They showed me all the parts that were being replaced (way passed the point of needing replacement) and I felt like the entire interaction was one of the most honest I’ve had with any mechanic. Being new to the area, I’ve found my permanent mechanic for any of my car needs. Super fast, friendly and honest work! And it’s always a plus to support a family owned business

reviews.author: Julie Swain
reviews.text: JD can really step up..we had a cascade of items fail on our 2013 dually exhaust system. JD was great at diagnosing the issues. He kept us informed the entire time. He would call and update us before we had a chance to check in on the truck. Highly recommend JD and his team.

reviews.author: Chris Miller
reviews.text: got new shocks and struts and now it feels better to drive and my tires will last so much longer thx.

reviews.author: Tom Bryant
reviews.text: Josh did a great job charging the AC on my Tacoma after I did a frame swap.. Still ice cold 2 years later. Thanks!

reviews.author: Robert Byrd
reviews.text: While visiting Ashe County we needed an oil change and tire rotation. Saw good reviews for JD Auto Care and was able to make an appointment for the next morning; work was completed in less than an hour.

reviews.author: James Frank
reviews.text: Took the family to the mountains for the weekend and had an issue which shut the door on our plans. Not a single person in town could help, not the dealerships, parts stores…no one. JD was closed and still came back to the shop to get us taken car of and back on the road to enjoy our weekend. He is the type of person the world needs more of! Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Steve Lowe
reviews.text: Very impressed with JDs Auto Care in West Jefferson, NC. I took my 1968 Mercury Cougar XR-7 into JD's for an issue I was having and they were able to quickly diagnose the problem and get me back on the road in minimal time. Ready for the "Cruise In" season now..... Thanks!

reviews.author: Garrett Bridger Gilmore
reviews.text: Our AC started breaking down while in town visiting family from Alabama. JD was willing to fit me in on an emergency basis, coming in early and fixing the problem so my family and I could drive home with a working AC. An honest, friendly, and kind mechanic. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Bubba Louie
reviews.text: Had a broken exhaust pipe on my caddy. The staff was friendly and honest. No price gouging, just good honest and very reasonable work. Car was in and out in no time.

reviews.author: Stephen York
reviews.text: My experience with "JD's" Auto Care has been fantastic. This young man is honest, very knowledgeable and has the experience you know you can trust. Thanks Josh, for opening your shop.

reviews.author: Irene Waddle
reviews.text: My husband and I where traveling down The Blue ridge Mtn. detour in our RV and we lost our breaks was barely by GODS hand only able to stop in a gravel area across from sheets store and JD'S Auto Care came to our rescue had us up and going the next day because of parts (it was the Master cylinder that had gone out) very kind and very professional I would HIGHLY recommend them. A big thank you to JD'S Auto Care you were such a blessing!

reviews.author: Maria Pramaggiore
reviews.text: The BEST auto shop anywhere. Service is great. I needed a side mirror replaced and waited less than an hour.

reviews.author: Bonny Becker
reviews.text: I recently moved to West Jefferson and needed a machanic. I found JD's Auto Care online. After reading all the reviews I called and he took me right away. JD found the problem (and helped me understand the problem). He fixed it and I was on my way. I highly recommend JD's Auto Care to anyone looking for an honest and excellent machanic.

reviews.author: Lisa Brinton
reviews.text: Very respectful. Consulted with me over price's and procedures before working on my car. Day in and day out completion. Overall a great and painless experience. Thank you and I will be a repeat customer

reviews.author: Linda Paisley
reviews.text: Would definitely recommend to anyone. Courteous and attention to details. Went above and beyond to try to help. Really are good people worth taking ur business too! Will use again for my car Maintenance needs for sure

reviews.author: Michele Muth
reviews.text: I’m pretty new to the area and think that JDs Auto Care is my greatest find. Clean and comfortable waiting room and everyone is super friendly. I will gladly recommend to all my friends

reviews.author: Nathan Ham
reviews.text: Great shop that will get to the bottom of whatever problem your vehicle is having. Highly recommend to anybody that needs an honest mechanic to do the job right.

reviews.author: john garland
reviews.text: An excellent auto repair experience. Easy scheduling, friendly and fair. Always done on time and great communication and advice. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Will Caseber
reviews.text: Lifesaver! Visiting town and woke on a Saturday with tire pressure down - nail. JD fit us in, patched us up quickly, and got us on our way. And thanks to Jose for the tour!

reviews.author: Barry Hopkins
reviews.text: Replaced heater core under extended warranty. Good service and courteous employees. Will use them again, as in the past.

reviews.author: alexander jackson
reviews.text: Best auto shop around! JD knows what he’s doing, without a doubt, he’ll get you fixed right and back on the road for a good price!!

reviews.author: Yvonne Deemer
reviews.text: JD’s autocare is efficient, knowledgeable, reliable, helpful and friendly. We have found our new service station for our vehicles!!

reviews.author: Trevor Kanupp
reviews.text: Great place to take any vehicle problems to. Very knowledgeable and nice. Explained everything to me and gave me options for solutions. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Todd Kruszka
reviews.text: JD is not a mechanic, he is a magician. I showed up with a broken car at opening time and left at lunchtime with a fixed car. Prompt, friendly, complete service.

reviews.author: Evan Lugten
reviews.text: JD was able to diagnose that it was a coolant issue and took care of the problem right away. Thank You!

reviews.author: Sandy Gelb
reviews.text: Wonderful experience!! Everyone was kind, helpful and knowledgeable. They fit me in quickly- I highly recommend and will be a repeat customer!

reviews.author: Chris Walker
reviews.text: Can't say enough about the care, courtesy, and overall treatment they extend to the public. These are fine young men, and I will do business with them again and happily refer others to them.

reviews.author: Jana
reviews.text: Great service! I like doing business locally and not having to drive to Wilkes or Boone. I highly recommend for auto repair.

reviews.author: Nichole Peralta Azor
reviews.text: The staff are so friendly and helpful. They are transparent with their service and willing to go above and beyond to make sure you’re comfortable and getting the best value.

reviews.author: Heidi Badiano
reviews.text: I had a slow leak on a Friday no less went in and they took care of me. Friendly service. I will go back!

reviews.author: Debbie Hawkins
reviews.text: The owner and his wife are terrific and he is the best mechanic that I have ever met.His prices are also fair.

reviews.author: Zack Church
reviews.text: Communicated through the repairs and did great work. Honest in all my dealings with them. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lindsey P
reviews.text: Friendly family owned and operated shop that provides excellent service and value. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rose Glazier
reviews.text: Really happy with my experience at JD’s Auto! I had car trouble while visiting the area for a funeral and needed a starter replaced unexpectedly on my 2009 Honda Accord. They were able to get me an appointment for the next morning and replace it quickly. The price for an OEM starter was very reasonable. The staff were all so friendly, helpful, and easy to work with throughout the whole process. When my check engine light came on afterward, they were happy to take another look and make sure everything was okay. While waiting again, they were kind enough to offer me gift cards for the inconvenience. The gift cards definitely weren’t necessary, but they were such a thoughtful gesture and very much appreciated! It’s stressful dealing with unexpected car trouble, especially when you’re away from home, but JD’s Auto made the experience about as easy as it could have been. I really appreciate how helpful and genuinely caring everyone was. I would definitely recommend JD’s Auto!
